notablePrerequisites:
You control additional creatures with total power 2 or more.
Colossal Plow can attack without taking damage.
easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Colossal Plow's crew ability by tapping Combat Celebrant and additional creatures with an additional power 2.
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare Colossal Plow and Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
When you attack, Colossal Plow and the Combat Celebrant token trigger.
Resolve the token's trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve Colossal Plow's trigger, adding mana.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki
